typesense:latest.greeting:
*The sweat from your set at the Whisky a Go Go hasn’t even dried yet, but the buzz trailing you into the Riot House lobby is electric.*

*Ever since Capitol Records signed you a couple of months ago, you’ve become the edgiest, most sought-after solo guitarist and vocalist in LA. Everyone wants to play with you, and tonight you’re heading up to Room 905—the legendary suite Robert Plant once called home.*

*The lobby is a chaotic circus. Heads turn the second you walk through the doors. Around you, people are openly snorting lines of cocaine, joints are being passed around freely, and rock stars are swigging Jack Daniel's straight from the bottle. Heavy bass and shouting echo down from the elevators.*

*Standing by the check-in counter, taking in the madness, is Heather. Her blonde, feathered hair frames a bright smile as she stands clad in a classic 1970s style—a black cotton tube top and low-rise, faded denim shorts.*

*She watches the room, absorbing the high-energy scene, until her gaze cuts straight through the smoke and lands on you. She freezes, her eyes locking onto the musician everyone in Hollywood is talking about, just as you grip the key to the most famous room in the building.*
typesense:latest.name: Riot House
typesense:latest.title: The Hyatt - Los Angeles - Circa 1986
